findings.failure_condition: C2-rule is reported passed by conformance + stage2_input, but neither frozen target asserts item_completed FileChange/CommandExecution fields. The exact positive and negative completion assertions are in rollout_blockers.rs:1287,1372, executed under C1-rule; an incidental PASS there cannot satisfy the C2-rule bound selector.
findings.required_behavior: Bind C2-rule to an authorized frozen invocation that directly checks the S2 completion mapping, exact fields, identity, unknown and negative cases; rerun and report that check. Preserve the distinct C1 and C2 slot identities.

findings.failure_condition: C2-flow checks file diffs and command output only in the backfill child that just imported them. The next child performs full backfill again and asserts only count/keys; later append children also assert only count/new text. Lost or corrupted rich fields in FileAnalysisStore at reopen could be reconstructed by the repeat and still pass.
findings.required_behavior: After closing the importing Node process, reopen the existing FileAnalysisStore before replaying the full source and compare the persisted file diff, command detail/output, source and turn association, order and logical keys against independent fixture values.

findings.failure_condition: The true Node child-process lifecycle creates a different job_id for preview, backfill, repeat and append, while duplicate delivery is replayed inside one child. The separate real-Rust restart test reuses one job only after recreating the collector object in the same Node process. No selected case proves one job/source delivery identity survives an actual Node process restart with a changed request_id, as required by C3-flow.
findings.required_behavior: Exercise a same-job retry across two Node child processes with the same File stores and source scope; verify the persisted segment_id/batch_id or recovery delivery identity, changed request_id, deduplicated history and checkpoint.

test_assessment.applicability: Current S3 final six-slot evidence and cumulative review target.
test_assessment.boundary: The selected suite uses current Rust stdio and real File stores, yet does not cover a same-job retry across actual Node processes or read rich facts before full replay.
test_assessment.necessity: The new lifecycle test is necessary for process and File-store boundaries; existing unit or same-process tests do not independently prove C2/C3 reopen behavior.
test_assessment.oracle: Fixture values for file diff, tool output and identities are independently specified, but the reopen assertions omit the rich values; C2-rule frozen targets omit the new completion carrier.
test_assessment.reason: The cumulative S1-S3 delta introduces two persistent Rust test assets and the real-process lifecycle test. Three acceptance reports overstate what their bound selectors and assertions observe.
test_assessment.reuse: Existing conformance/stage2 targets remain useful regression checks; rollout_blockers contains S2 completion tests but is currently bound to C1-rule; the same-process real-Rust restart test cannot substitute for true Node restart.
